comment: The single list of public mods: every build, packaging, verification and publishing script reads it, and mod submissions add to it. 'folder' is the project under mods/cs, 'modId' the mod's Id in game, 'id' its catalog package. 'legacy' mods keep the historical JibbersMods/<id>.dll path that installed bootstraps migrate from native plugins; the others install as JibbersMods/cs/<id>.dll. 'version' is the lowest version the package may publish at; without it a mod starts at 0.1.0 and goes one patch above its published version each time its files change, independent of the loader's build number. 'defaultInstall' adds a mod to the loader's required dependencies so startup installs it without a catalogue selection. 'authors' are the GitHub accounts that may submit updates to a mod (maintainers always can).

mods.name: Alpine Vision
mods.description: Atmosphere extended: weather, alpine sky, lighting and a URP cinematic finish. Retains game shadows. Replaces Atmosphere.

mods.name: Rewind
mods.description: C# physics history, hold to rewind and resume.

mods.name: FPV Drone
mods.description: C# drone flight, camera, controls, HUD and audio.

mods.name: Slow Motion
mods.description: Click the left stick or press V to slow the game down, with smooth easing.

mods.name: Rumble
mods.description: Controller vibration that follows the game's own sounds: landings, rails, crashes and hard carves. Xbox and PlayStation pads.

mods.name: SLVSH
mods.description: S.K.A.T.E. on snow with your Steam party: set tricks, match them, watch each turn and vote on close calls.

mods.name: Chair Lift
mods.description: Ride the chair lifts: sit with friends, use the phone on the way up, get off at the top.

mods.name: Async Content
mods.description: Reduces server-join stutter by decoding session textures and meshes on a worker and spreading large texture copies across frames.

mods.name: Hank Mod Pack
mods.description: Controller quick menu, Improved Spawn, free look, play and replay cameras, HUD themes, replay effects, trick banners and custom media.

mods.name: Render Distance
mods.description: Uncaps the game's Terrain and Object Render Distance options past 1500 m (up to 50 km).

mods.name: Spotify
mods.description: See and control what is playing in Spotify: a spinning record with album art, skip/seek/shuffle, and a mini Spotify app on the phone. No login.
